dedupe_keys.name: yemen health facilities 2025 list of about 5 000 facilities by governorate and district with structure type and coordinates available on request through hdx

description: This data set is the humanitarian community's list of health facilities in Yemen, a country where years of conflict have damaged the health system and many services run from temporary structures. It is maintained by the UN humanitarian office in Yemen (OCHA) with humanitarian partners and listed on the Humanitarian Data Exchange. According to its metadata it holds about 5,000 facilities, each with governorate, district, whether the structure is temporary or permanent, name, facility type and coordinates, for 2025. Coverage is national. The list is not open for direct download: it is available free on request through the exchange's data request service, and no licence is stated. Caveats: access has to be requested and may be limited to humanitarian use, the fields and row count come from the listing, not the file, and functionality or damage status is not among the listed fields. Simulation uses: mapping health facilities against conflict, flood and cholera outbreak areas, and planning humanitarian health logistics and access. Related records: Healthsites.io (data-healthsites-io) gives open facility points, and the WHO attacks on health care surveillance (data-who-ssa-attacks-on-health-care) records attacks affecting facilities in emergency settings.
